# PDF.js

Version: 4.10.38, from the official `pdfjs-dist` npm package.

The minified library, worker, and standard fonts are served locally so the paper figures do not require a third-party PDF viewer at runtime. The upstream Apache 2.0 license is included in `LICENSE`; individual font licenses are preserved in `standard_fonts`.

Upstream: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
